verdict.rationale: Benchmark Email is an email platform, so a transactional-sending axis applies. However, the documented API covers only contacts, lists, campaigns, reports and domains. Campaign setup via the API ends with opening the campaign 'in Benchmark to make final edits and send', and nothing documents a one-to-one transactional send endpoint for receipts, magic links or notifications.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send one-to-one transactional email — receipts, magic links, notifications — through the same platform's API alongside marketing sends
